article.title: How LiteLLM Turned Developer Machines Into Credential Vaults for Attackers
article.content: A security report reveals how LiteLLM proxy servers, used by developers to manage multiple AI models, can inadvertently expose API keys and credentials stored on developer machines. The vulnerability allows attackers to access sensitive credentials through misconfigured proxy servers.

article.title: NVIDIA Announces Blackwell AI Platform with 5x Performance Boost
article.content: NVIDIA has unveiled its next-generation Blackwell AI platform, claiming a 5x performance improvement over previous Hopper architecture. The new platform features advanced tensor cores and improved memory bandwidth, targeting large language model training and inference workloads.

article.title: Fed Signals Caution on Rate Cuts as Inflation Remains Sticky
article.content: Federal Reserve officials have indicated they will proceed cautiously with interest rate cuts, as inflation data remains higher than expected. The central bank's latest minutes show policymakers are concerned about persistent price pressures in the services sector.

translations.chinese_title: 聯準會對降息持謹慎態度，因通膨
translations.full_response: - Translated title: 聯準會對降息持謹慎態度，因通膨

*   Title: "Fed Signals Caution on Rate Cuts as Inflation Remains Sticky"
    *   Content: "Federal Reserve officials have indicated they will proceed cautiously with interest rate cuts, as inflation data remains higher than expected. The central bank's latest minutes show policymakers are concerned about persistent price pressures in the services sector."
    *   Target Language: Traditional Chinese (繁體中文).
    *   Output Format:
        *   Translated title.
        *   Translated summary (approx. 80 characters).
        *   Translation quality notes.

    *   *Fed*: Federal Reserve $\rightarrow$ 美聯儲 (common in mainland/global) or 美國聯準會 (standard in Taiwan). Since the request is for Traditional Chinese (often associated with Taiwan/HK), "美國聯準會" or "聯準會" is more natural.
    *   *Signals Caution*: 表達謹慎 / 釋出謹慎訊號.
    *   *Rate Cuts*: 降息.
    *   *Inflation Remains Sticky*: 通膨依然具有黏性 / 通膨居高不下 / 通膨難以下降. "Sticky" in economics refers to prices/inflation that don't adjust quickly. "黏性" is the technical term, but "居高不下" is more natural for a general news headline.

    *   *Federal Reserve officials have indicated they will proceed cautiously with interest rate cuts*: 聯準會官員表示，他們將謹慎採取降息行動.
    *   *as inflation data remains higher than expected*: 因為通膨數據仍高於預期.
    *   *The central bank's latest minutes show*: 央行最新的會議紀錄顯示.
    *   *policymakers are concerned about persistent price pressures in the services sector*: 決策者對服務業持續存在的價格壓力感到擔憂.

    *   *Title:* 通膨居高不下，聯準會釋出對降息持謹慎態度訊號 (A bit long). $\rightarrow$ 通膨仍具黏性，聯準會對降息採取謹慎態度.
    *   *Summary:* 聯準會官員表示，由於通膨數據高於預期，將謹慎處理降息進程。最新會議紀錄顯示，決策者對服務業持續的價格壓力深感憂慮。 (Approx 60 characters - fits the "about 80" requirement).

    *   *Difficulty:* "Sticky inflation" is a technical term. Using "黏性" is accurate for finance, but "居高不下" is better for general readability.
    *   *Terminology:* Used "聯準會" (Federal Reserve) and "降息" (Rate cuts).
